gmt.scope: actual complete CPU model, fixed checkpoint strict load, frozen; inherited training-only unregistered center-loss tensors constructed on CPU instead of forced CUDA

vggt.scope: total is original official pre-pruning count; resident_parameters is exact pinned module count after removing point/depth/track heads, structurally verified on meta against prior full loaded-model count; storage estimate is separate from measured CUDA peaks

dinov2.scope: recorded actual independent frozen DINO model

scopes.cuda: PyTorch per-process allocator peak, not all processes or complete device occupancy
scopes.host: process lifetime maximum RSS where recorded, including initialization; not synchronized with CUDA/cache peak
scopes.original_tracker: deduplicated retained tensor/NumPy storage at final publication, not lifetime peak and not Python object overhead; original GMT history is unchanged and unbounded
scopes.cache: target vector cache and retrieval index are separate payloads, not total system memory caps
scopes.missing: null means not measured; never substitute zero; do not add noncoincident peaks
